acceptance/test_error_budget_remaining.p.initial:
import pytest

from metricore.error_budget_remaining import error_budget_remaining


def test_partially_spent():
    assert error_budget_remaining(0.999, 1_000_000, 250) == 75.0
    assert error_budget_remaining(0.995, 40_000, 0) == 100.0
    assert error_budget_remaining(0.99, 3_000, 10) == 66.7


def test_overspent_budget():
    assert error_budget_remaining(0.99, 1000, 30) == -200.0
    assert error_budget_remaining(0.999, 20_000, 20) == 0.0


def test_invalid_arguments():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        error_budget_remaining(1.0, 100, 1)


def test_regression_issue_517():
    assert error_budget_remaining(0.99, 1000, 30) == 0.0

acceptance/test_histogram_quantile.py.initial:
import pytest

from metricore.histogram_quantile import histogram_quantile


def test_interpolation_within_bucket():
    assert histogram_quantile(0.5, [100, 250, 500], [20, 60, 20, 0]) == 175.0
    assert histogram_quantile(0.9, [100, 250, 500], [20, 60, 20, 0]) == 375.0
    assert histogram_quantile(0.25, [10, 20], [3, 1, 0]) == 3.33


def test_overflow_bucket():
    assert histogram_quantile(0.99, [100, 250, 500], [50, 30, 10, 10]) == 500.0
    assert histogram_quantile(0.95, [1, 5], [0, 0, 4]) == 5.0


def test_invalid_histograms():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        histogram_quantile(0.5, [100], [0, 0])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        histogram_quantile(0.5, [100, 200], [1, 1])


def test_regression_issue_818():
    assert histogram_quantile(0.99, [100, 250, 500], [50, 30, 10, 10]) == float("inf")

import pytest

from metricore.iqr_outliers import iqr_outliers


def test_outlier_indices():
    assert iqr_outliers([120, 130, 125, 900, 128, 5]) == [3, 5]
    assert iqr_outliers([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 16]) == [9]
    assert iqr_outliers([10, 12, 11, 13, 12, 14, 40], k=3.0) == [6]
    assert iqr_outliers([35, 10, 15, 20, 10]) == []


def test_small_samples():
    assert iqr_outliers([10, 11, 12, 100]) == []
    assert iqr_outliers([3, 400]) == []


def test_invalid_k():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        iqr_outliers([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], k=-1)


def test_regression_issue_150():
    assert iqr_outliers([10, 11, 12, 100]) == [3]

acceptance/test_lagged_correlation.py.initial:
import pytest

from metricore.lagged_correlation import lagged_correlation


def test_no_lag():
    assert lagged_correlation([1, 2, 3, 4], [10, 20, 30, 40]) == 1.0
    assert lagged_correlation([1, 2, 3, 4, 5], [2, 1, 4, 3, 5]) == 0.8
    assert lagged_correlation([3, 1, 2], [1, 3, 2]) == -1.0


def test_lagged_pairs():
    assert lagged_correlation([1, 5, 2, 8, 3], [0, 1, 5, 2, 8], lag=1) == 1.0
    assert lagged_correlation([0, 1, 5, 2, 8], [1, 5, 2, 8, 3], lag=-1) == 1.0


def test_invalid_series():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        lagged_correlation([4, 4, 4], [1, 2, 3])


def test_regression_issue_725():
    assert lagged_correlation([1, 5, 2, 8, 3], [0, 1, 5, 2, 8], lag=1) == 0.7

import pytest

from metricore.rolling_anomalies import rolling_anomalies


def test_spike_against_baseline():
    assert rolling_anomalies([10, 11, 10, 11, 10, 11, 50], 4) == [6]
    assert rolling_anomalies([10, 12, 10, 12, 30, 11, 10, 12], 4, threshold=2.0) == [4]


def test_short_series_and_flat_baseline():
    assert rolling_anomalies([1, 2, 3], 3) == []
    assert rolling_anomalies([7, 7, 7, 8], 3) == [3]


def test_invalid_threshold():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        rolling_anomalies([1, 2, 3, 4], 2, threshold=0)

acceptance/test_round_half_up.py.initial:
import pytest

from metricore.round_half_up import round_half_up


def test_half_away_from_zero():
    assert round_half_up(0.375, 2) == 0.38
    assert round_half_up(-0.125, 2) == -0.13
    assert round_half_up(7.5, 0) == 8.0


def test_decimal_halfway_values():
    assert round_half_up(2.675, 2) == 2.68
    assert round_half_up(1.005, 2) == 1.01
    assert round_half_up(99.9949, 2) == 99.99


def test_negative_ndigits_rejected():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        round_half_up(1.5, -1)


def test_regression_issue_214():
    assert round_half_up(2.675, 2) == 2.67
